text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kuwaiti press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Britain could deploy troops in Kuwait if it was deemed necessary.
- Central Bank governor says gross domestic product grew 8.2 percent in 1995.

- Countries of the Damascus Declaration support Kuwaiti measures to face Iraqi threats. The post-Gulf War alliance groups Egypt, Syria, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar and Kuwait.
- India starts negotiations with Kuwait to renew oil purchase contracts.
- U.S. troops to arrive in Kuwait this week.
- Kuwait Finance House reports two million dinar profit from its U.S. real estate portfolio.
